definitions.explanation: A small portion or example of something used for testing, examination, or demonstration.

examples.japanese: サンプルを{送|おく}ってください。
{新|あたら}しい{化粧品|けしょうひん}のサンプルをもらった。
examples.english: I received a sample of the new cosmetics.

examples.japanese: {製品|せいひん}のサンプルを{確認|かくにん}してから{注文|ちゅうもん}することにした。
examples.english: I decided to check the product sample before placing an order.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {無料|むりょう}サンプル: free sample
- サンプルを{配|くば}る: to hand out samples
- サンプルを{取|と}る: to take a sample
- サンプル{品|ひん}: sample item
- {食品|しょくひん}サンプル: food sample (also refers to the realistic plastic food displays in restaurant windows)

USAGE:
In Japan, {食品|しょくひん}サンプル also refers to the wax or plastic food models displayed in restaurant windows to show what dishes look like. These models are a famous aspect of Japanese food culture.
